prompt: A data check on product names: most names end with a space and a three-character model number, as in Lumio Air 564. From the products table, return two columns, in this order: product_id, product_name. Keep only the products whose product_name breaks this rule, that is, whose fourth character from the end is not a space. The three characters after that space can be any characters, spaces included, and a name shorter than four characters breaks the rule too. Every product has a product_name. Return one row per product. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the row filter. Keep a product when its name does not end with a space and exactly three characters.
Write the pattern for the names that follow the rule, then keep the names that do not match it. Each _ stands for exactly one character, and a pattern must match the whole name.
why_this_works: Each _ matches exactly one character, so the pattern ends in a space and three characters, and NOT LIKE keeps the names that break it.
